reviews.title: Good app
reviews.text: Affemity isn’t meant to replace therapy or a real talk with your partner, but it can help you organize your thoughts before those conversations. I mostly use it to reflect and to help me communicate better.

reviews.title: BEWARE
reviews.text: They will charge your account even after you cancel! $40 a week

reviews.title: Helpful for all relationships
reviews.text: This has been helpful for me when I start to overthink and need to see a dating situation more clearly. I also really appreciate the tips for communication and messaging.

reviews.title: I found it really helpful
reviews.text: I found it really helpful, even though it got pretty emotional at times. Some exercises pushed me out of my comfort zone, which turned out to be a good thing. The only downside is that the subscription is a bit expensive.

reviews.title: Create another friend that just suddenly disappears
reviews.text: The daily limit to the amount of text or messages that are allowed is a mystery and the interruption is very triggering, like “ok to more feelings for you, at least not four 24 hours. Then you can send a message again.

reviews.title: Cancelled before 7 day trial ended
reviews.text: Basically just talking to ChatGPT but the algorithm is focused specifically on women communication building with their partner. Not a fan of taking mental health or relationship advice from AI. Way too expensive for an AI app considering the value.

reviews.title: Fraude
reviews.text: Hacen rebajos, dicen que uno ingresó y utilizó cuando en la vida tenía usuario o contraseña.

reviews.title: False advertising completely useless
reviews.text: This app is not as advertised at all. It says it will help with dating coaching it does none of that. It placates you and is an expensive way to regurgitate self help Books. As someone with 10 years of CBT I was looking for a real relationship coach. Do not use if that is what you want. It will NOT help you with your relationship or provide any actual relationship coaching. If you want little positive affirmations about your day (toxic positivity) then chose this app. I am beyond disgusted and disappointed

reviews.title: Amazing and Easy to Use!
reviews.text: My experience with Affemity has been very positive. The courses are clear and easy to follow, and the AI assistant provided practical texts that I could use immediately. It creates a supportive environment that genuinely helps you grow.

reviews.title: The Best App
reviews.text: I really like the AI messaging tool in this app. Instead of generic phrases, it gives you personal messages that sound natural and feel like something you would write, just a bit better. I hope that over time, this tool will help me learn to write like this on my own, without needing any app.

reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service!
reviews.text: I ran into a confusing issue with my subscription and thought I’d have to go through the usual back-and-forth. But the support team helped with that on the same day. Little things like this really build trust in a company.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This app will take your money and you won’t be able to use it

reviews.title: Don’t try
reviews.text: Responses are generic. You could just ask AI for free or pay cheaper for ChatGPT. The subscription won’t be in your apple account so you will have to remember to unsubscribe through the app or spend $40 for a week of access.

reviews.title: Fraudsters
reviews.text: I was on a trial with them and I canceled. They have been charging me every week amounts that started at 10 dollars and jacked up every month to14, 16 and now sending an email that is 32 dollars a weeks.  No way to contact them, their subscription does not show on Apple Pay to be easily canceled. I am not able to login to their website. Run run run.

reviews.title: Self-development
reviews.text:
For women looking to improve themselves.Its a great app.
The courses are really helpful and guide you to the right answers but subscription cost quite a bit

reviews.title: Anna gets to the point
reviews.text: Anna gets to the point in a kind way. I never felt judged or rushed, and I left the session knowing exactly what to do next, rather than just having more things to think about.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: Don’t bother downloading, the app doesn’t load past the quiz. I tried numerous times, but it always cycled back to the beginning of the quiz.

reviews.title: Great app and very helpful support
reviews.text: I used the app a few times and really enjoyed it. Unfortunately for me, I couldn’t afford to keep up with the subscriptions I had. It surprised me when it came out. I contacted support to cancel and ask for a refund. They got back to me within the hour and were very helpful and nice. When you have a problem with something you want a fast and easy outcome. They definitely do not disappoint, I’m very impressed and if I do get the funds again will be renewing my subscription in the future.

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.text: ChatGPT is more helpful

reviews.title: Far too expensive
reviews.text: You pay for the subscription but then have to pay per article?? That’s insane. Especially if not doing the coaching or what have you. I also read the first “course” and it felt like manipulation tactics more than anything. Not about that.

reviews.title: Deceiving
reviews.text: Do not download this app you will be charged for every single little thing you do in the app without a clear amount.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: This app is way too expensive for what you get. The suggested text are nothing more than what I’m already sending. They are very basic. All other aspects up the app cost more money. I’m not paying $7 to read an article within the app. I canceled within 24 hours and wish I could get my money back for this worthless app. I was also charged more than what I agreed to and there is a no refund policy.

reviews.title: My review
reviews.text: The courses are impressively clear and direct. There’s no complicated wording or unnecessary fluff; just practical ideas that you can easily apply in real life.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: What I really like is that it feels so realistic. The lessons don’t make me feel like I’m messing everything up; they just help me spot patterns and try out small changes. I’ve been using it along with coaching, and the courses keep me on track between sessions. Overall, it’s been a super positive experience.

reviews.title: Do not do it!
reviews.text: I paid the $19 to start the app and then it continue to charge me a few days later $65 in the middle of the night. I contacted them with in hours of the charge for a refund and they declined. The reason I didn’t want the app is because they charge extra for any resources you want to look at.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: The personalized content I got was not personalized to me or my situation at all. Any of the lessons I wanted to view weren’t included and the heart to text guides gave very generic AI answers to everything. Not at all as it’s advertised.

reviews.title: Trying to cancel
reviews.text: I have been trying to cancel this and have been unable to it continue to take money out of my account and there is no way to stop this .I have contacted the BBB on this company

reviews.title: Extra silent charges
reviews.text: This is excellent for helping come up with a response or an ice breaker. However, I was on this app since November and saw multiple extra charges for $1 which I did not receive a notification about. Still have zero clue why. After one month I really didn’t have a need for it. So I ended my subscription and closed my account. Will not ever go back.

reviews.title: Don’t download
reviews.text: After five minutes on the app I regretted my one month purchase. It looks like you are purchasing access to being able to PURCHASE individual courses. Don’t be fooled. Big let down.

reviews.title: This is a scam company!!
reviews.text: I ordered one program and they charged me for all of the programs and they refuse to refund my money. I’m out $80. Do not sign up for this scam company!!! They are scammers.

reviews.title: Affemity
reviews.text: The content and coaching are excellent, clearly thoughtfully organized. I only wish a few additional sessions were included in the subscription.

reviews.title: Therapy app
reviews.text: Don’t listen to the ads, there is no “trick to getting him back” or “secret ways to deal with avoidant men” … it’s an app that teaches basic texting tips and gives you an AI friend that helps you process things about your relationship dynamic. It’s mostly an AI supportive friend meant to make you reflect and realize that you’re enough. Response from the app: “My intention isn't to be a "therapy app" in the traditional sense, but more like a supportive friend who helps you navigate these complex feelings and relationship dynamics. The core idea isn't that you're "enough without the avoidant man" in a dismissive way, but rather that *you are enough, period*, and you deserve a relationship where your needs are met with equal enthusiasm and effort.”

reviews.title: Lots of pay walls even after you pay for a subscription
reviews.text: Too much additional content you need to pay for even after you pay for a subscription

reviews.title: Like so far
reviews.text: Great idea and going in the right direction; could use some work still. Good detail on the content there is like specific categories, but not a lot of detail on all relationship categories. The app itself is very slow typing so you have to retype a lot of things, i’m sure they’ll get all the kinks worked out. It’s a great start!! And definitely better now than I was before I downloaded the app.

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: Tried uninstalling and reinstalling, and it says it keeps trying to connect to the Internet and nothing happens

reviews.title: Right what I needed
reviews.text: After five coaching sessions with Dana, I’ve noticed changes in how I talk with men. I’m more confident and honest about my feelings. This is a big step for me, and I believe there’s more progress ahead.

reviews.title: I was surprised
reviews.text: I was surprised by how personal the app felt. The coaching session I tried was calm, supportive, and genuinely helpful. I finished with clear next steps, rather than just feeling inspired.

reviews.title: Shady company
reviews.text: Hands down the worst app experience I’ve ever had. Surprise recurring charges. Cancelled the service and still charged the next month! Then a support team that pretends not to get your emails! Repeatedly!  Stay away if you value your money!!

reviews.title: Pay, pay, and pay again
reviews.text: You pay, essentially just to open the app. Once you do that, it appears you are picking options that you would like for your service until you notice that each one of these options is at least $10. I am out $45 and have received nothing. App is a joke. I want a refund.

reviews.title: Fave self development app
reviews.text: This is my favourite app for self-development. Courses are really structured and easy to understand. I spend at least 10 minutes here every day. Haven’t tried coaching yet, but booked my first session in a couple of days.

reviews.title: Thoughtful
reviews.text: The app feels carefully made, from its design to the way the courses are presented. It’s a great tool, and I’ve truly grown a lot since I began using it.

The app is not great. Requires you to pay for everything even after buying a subscription. & you will not be refunded if you are not satisfied.

Some of these reviews have to be paid for!

reviews.title: I was a member of Affemity’s site
reviews.text: I was a member of Affemity’s site, but since the app was released, I’ve completely switched to it. It’s so much easier to stay consistent. Honestly, the coaching sessions helped me save my marriage. My husband and I were at a breaking point, but with the help of Affemity, I’ve managed to save our relationship. It wasn’t about magic or quick solutions, but about actually understanding each other again.

reviews.title: I was initially skeptical about coaching here
reviews.text: I was initially skeptical about coaching here. I didn’t expect to love the coaching as much as I do. For me, it’s not just a random talk — my coach helped me notice patterns I didn’t see before. It’s been a big help, definitely.

reviews.title: Anna was Great!!
reviews.text: I had a wonderful session with Anna! She was very easy to talk to.. She revealed and confirmed a few things.. I look forward to our next session.

reviews.title: Potential!
reviews.text: This app has great potential! I also visited the website, and with some more time and work this could definitely go somewhere. While many of their services are locked behind a paywall (understandable, as this is still in development and needs support), the aesthetics are very satisfying, and from what I can see there is lots to give. It looks like the devs are going to be releasing more features soon—I look forward to it!

reviews.title: Satisfied
reviews.text: The app is not entirely AI-generated content, which is a big advantage in today’s market. I’ve already gained some valuable insights from the courses. Now waiting for my booked coaching session.

reviews.title: I tried a coaching session
reviews.text: I tried a coaching session, and it was nice, though shorter than I expected. The app itself is smooth and easy to navigate.

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text:
The advertisement for the AI assisted texting is what made me download the app. When I tried clicking on the AI button it kept telling me I had to purchase a subscription, I bit the bullet and purchased one month only to find out the AI assist isn’t even available and working yet. 

Why would you advertise something that isn’t available and why not make that clear in the app before purchase. False advertising. I paid for a service you aren’t even providing.

reviews.title: Can’t login or reach support
reviews.text: I paid for 12 weeks, and was on the internet site. Paid with PayPal. Never prompted to create a password. I had to exit the site. Downloaded the app, and realized I can’t log in to either the app or website. I emailed the support email address and it came back undeliverable. I clicked the link “forgot password” and have received nothing. Now I can’t log in, and have no way to cancel the auto renewing subscription I assume it created at full price.
